dry-rot.risk: Dry rot compromises structural wood in your home, spreading silently and weakening load-bearing elements
dry-rot.value: Removing and replacing rotted wood stops the spread and restores structural integrity

leak.risk: Water intrusion can cause hidden mold growth, damage insulation, and rot structural framing inside your walls
leak.value: Sealing entry points protects your home's interior from moisture damage and health hazards

siding.risk: Damaged or missing siding leaves your home exposed to weather, pests, and accelerating deterioration
siding.value: New siding is your home's first line of defense — it protects the structure and restores curb appeal

windows.risk: Failing window frames and flashing allow water behind your walls where you can't see the damage building
windows.value: Properly sealed windows stop hidden moisture intrusion and improve energy efficiency

doors.risk: Deteriorated door frames and thresholds are common entry points for water and pest intrusion
doors.value: Restored door framing seals your home's envelope and prevents costly interior damage

trim.risk: Rotting trim allows water to wick into the wall structure behind it
trim.value: Fresh trim seals transitions and protects the underlying framing from moisture

deck.risk: A compromised deck is a safety hazard — rotted joists and boards can fail under load
deck.value: Rebuilt deck structure ensures safe use for your family and extends the life of the investment

crawlspace.risk: Moisture and rot in the crawlspace can undermine your home's foundation and floor structure
crawlspace.value: Crawlspace repairs protect the foundation and prevent floor sagging or structural failure

chimney.risk: Deteriorated chimney flashing and masonry allows water into your roof and wall systems
chimney.value: Chimney repairs seal a critical roof penetration and prevent interior water damage

flashing.risk: Failed flashing at roof-wall junctions is one of the most common causes of hidden water damage
flashing.value: Proper flashing directs water away from vulnerable transitions in your home

beam.risk: Compromised beams put your home's structural safety at risk
beam.value: New structural beams restore load-bearing capacity and long-term safety

mold.risk: Mold growth indicates moisture problems and poses health risks to your household
mold.value: Mold remediation and moisture source correction protects your family's health

lead-paint.risk: Lead paint disturbed during renovation creates toxic dust hazardous to your family
lead-paint.value: Proper containment and abatement eliminates the exposure risk

restoration.risk: Accumulated deterioration reduces your home's safety, efficiency, and value
restoration.value: Comprehensive restoration brings your home back to solid, safe condition
